title: Chambers Finder CLI request, schemaVersion 1
description: One request: a postcode in England or Wales, and how many courts and chambers to list. A JSON array of these (at most 500) is a batch. Keys not listed are rejected (error code unknown_key).

schemaVersion.description: Optional. When present it must be 1.

postcode.description: A full postcode (M1 1AE, m11ae) or an outward code (LS1). Case and spacing do not matter. Outside England and Wales, or unknown, is refused with a stable error code.

courts.description: How many of the nearest courts to list.

chambers.description: How many of the nearest chambers to list.

radiusMiles.description: The travel radius in miles, or "all" for none. Default: the data file's own default (35). Chambers beyond it are still listed, marked withinRadius false.

courtId.description: Measure the chambers from this court (an id in finder-data.json) instead of the court nearest the postcode.

measureFrom.description: "court": the chambers nearest the chosen court. "postcode": the chambers nearest the postcode itself, as the page's postcode search shows them.
